subject: general
question: _______ is useful for the survival of species over time.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Variation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Variation** is essential for the **survival of species over time** as it helps organisms adapt to changing environments.
 
• It occurs due to **genetic differences** among individuals within a species.
 
• Variations can arise through processes like **mutation, recombination during reproduction, and environmental factors.**
 
• These differences may provide certain individuals with a **survival advantage**, especially when environmental conditions change.
 
• This mechanism leads to **natural selection**, which ensures that favorable traits are passed on to future generations.
 
• For example, the development of antibiotic resistance in bacteria is an outcome of **genetic variation** and selection pressure.
 
• It contributes to the **evolution of species**, ensuring long-term survival and adaptability.
 
• Without variation, species would be unable to cope with new challenges like **diseases, predators, or climate changes**, leading to extinction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Reproduction**__

 __
 
• **Reproduction** is the biological process by which new individual organisms are produced.
 
• It ensures the **continuity of species** but does not directly aid in the survival of species in changing environments.
 
• There are two types of reproduction: **sexual reproduction** (involving two parents and genetic variation) and **asexual reproduction** (involving one parent and no variation).
 
 
 
• **Budding**__
 __
 
• **Budding** is a type of **asexual reproduction** commonly seen in organisms like **yeast and hydra.**
 
• It involves the formation of a new organism from a **small projection or bud on the parent organism.**
 
• Since it is a type of asexual reproduction, it does not lead to genetic variation.
 
 
 
• **Population**__
 
 
• A **population** refers to the group of individuals of the same species living in a particular area.
 
• While the size and density of a population are important, they do not directly ensure the **survival of species** in changing environments.
